Name: MITRE ATT&CK Cloud Matrix for Oracle Cloud (OCI)
Description: Adversarial tactics and techniques mapping for OCI cloud infrastructure defenses and threat hunting.

Requirements.Name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
Requirements.Description: Detect and prevent compromise of valid cloud accounts through MFA enforcement and credential rotation.

Requirements.Name: Data from Cloud Storage Object Exposure
Requirements.Description: Prevent unauthorized exfiltration of sensitive data through public object storage buckets.

Requirements.Name: Impair Defenses: Disable Cloud Guard and Logging
Requirements.Description: Detect adversary attempts to disable security monitoring, modify audit rules, or tamper with security lists.

Requirements.Name: Remote Services: SSH / RDP Exposure
Requirements.Description: Prevent adversaries from gaining lateral movement or initial foothold via exposed management ports.
